# [2.225.0-dev.11](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v2.225.0-dev.10...v2.225.0-dev.11) (2024-05-14)

> [!NOTE]
> Now, you can select languages to be included (for `Translations` patch only) in the final app and provide your own custom translation `strings.xml` file. When you provide custom translation file, it will overwrite all other translations, if you want to assign your custom translation file to a specific language, please let me know and I will implement this feature.

### Features

* **YouTube - Translations:** Add compile time option to select custom language file ([a65679e](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/a65679e2c345065b7fa96fa62f0901085cd3472d))
